{{Quote|There are three of them. Nej'a Bertolo, ''[sic]'' Onli Shi'en, and Tiberus Anderlock. Every one a very dangerous individual. They were my targets and now they are yours. You are going to have to be the one to finally bring about their demise.|[[Insurgent]]|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Tiberus Anderlock''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Insurgent]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] [[Black Epsilon]] tasked a [[TIE pilot|pilot]] with assisting a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] squadron with [[Death/Legends|killing]] Anderlock while he piloted a [[Kihraxz assault fighter]] in the [[Dathomir system/Legends|Dathomir system]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tiberus Anderlock was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']], the [[2004]] expansion pack for the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
